row.body: The office key is issued for the leased suite before the building check is signed. The rent card marks the space occupied that morning.
row.title: Office lease before clearance

sidecar.gloss: An office is occupied before its building check is signed.
sidecar.rival_reading: A work group could lease the suite before an inspection; the card does not show whether anyone was turned away.

row.body: the toilet roll and hand radio were sealed together but never opened. soot darkens the bundle; clean outlines show it was packed before the fire.
row.title: missing count beside the toilet roll

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
